repository_base_role: Pre-change origin/main snapshot that establishes the existing ingestion, persistence, and BA1 selector path.
implementation_commit_role: Immutable parent code/test snapshot audited by the initial evidence-only commit; later evidence-only provenance corrections remain bound by the PR head and review route.

field_flow.annotation_writer: backend/annotation/engine.py _gnomad_to_row maps AF/AN to gnomad_af_* and gnomad_an_*
field_flow.assessment: backend/analysis/acmg.py AcmgEvidence consumes persisted gnomad_af_* and gnomad_an_* fields

benign_frequency_criteria.selection_rule: Choose the highest AF only among candidates whose paired AN meets BA1_MIN_OBSERVED_ALLELES; withhold when none qualifies.
benign_frequency_criteria.pm2_boundary: PM2 remains separate: _effective_af uses gnomad_af_popmax, then gnomad_af_global as a rarity fallback.

implementation_boundary: BS1 now uses the repository's pre-existing BA1 founder-excluding selector. The review follow-up moves BA1's existing observed-allele guard into candidate selection; neither change derives FAF from AF/AN or changes PM2.
retention: Repository code-path and field inventory only; no gnomAD data record is retained.
license_or_terms: N/A for this inventory: it copies no gnomAD source content or dataset payload.
